name: monodomain_restitution
description: Single-cell Mitchell-Schaeffer S1-S2 restitution curve (rfcs/0005-cardiac-electrophysiology.md Stage 1) -- the code-verification fixture for the ionic kinetics, not a tissue-level result.
provenance: numerical (deterministic fixed-dt=0.01ms explicit RK2; no closed-form reference exists for this model, see rfcs/0005 Verification strategy)

model.apd_definition: duration V >= v_gate (the model's own gate-switching threshold), not a repolarization-percentage convention

metrics.name: last_s1_apd_ms
metrics.note: 3rd S1 beat's own APD; used as the DI reference for every S2 trial

metrics.name: restitution_curve
metrics.note: APD increases monotonically with DI, saturating toward the steady-state APD (~263ms) at long DI -- the qualitative shape Mitchell & Schaeffer's own paper reports for this parameter set

notes: Regenerated by cargo test -p tpt-med-electrophysiology (S1S2Protocol::run with the values above).

A tissue-level (monodomain, multi-voxel) conduction-velocity golden entry is deferred -- see rfcs/0005-cardiac-electrophysiology.md's Verification strategy, which names grid-convergence (Richardson extrapolation) rather than a closed-form reference for that metric; it is not yet reduced to a single checked-in number.

Validation status: none -- this is a code-verification fixture (self-consistent numerical reproduction), not compared against patient or ex-vivo data. See the RFC's Motivation for the ASME V&V 40 'supporting' influence level this carries.
